messages:
arjun: Quick heads-up — I'm putting together a single reliability dashboard that combines runtime + routing signals: timeouts, 5xx, OOMs, degraded-mode enters/exits, and fallback counts. Need input on metric names, labels, and where to emit them (router vs runtime). Planning a short sync Wed 10am.

marie: +1. We should standardize labels: deployment, model, route, region, customer_tier. Dedicated customers need per-tenant breakdowns.

benji: Agree on labels. Propose prefixes: runtime.inference.*, router.routing.* , infra.kube.*. Example: runtime.inference.5xx_count, runtime.inference.timeout_p99, router.fallback_count.

susan: Important: include a fallback_reason tag with enums like {quantize, rate_limit, oom, model_unavailable, prefix_cache}. That lets us split automated fallbacks vs degradations.

marie: Small but important: telemetry team prefers deduped request counting (use a request_id) vs raw attempt counts. Otherwise retries will inflate metrics.

arjun: Good point — we should emit both. Two metrics per signal: attempts_total (raw attempts) and requests_failed_deduped_total (deduped by client request id). Names could be runtime.inference.attempts_total and runtime.inference.requests_failed_deduped_total.

benji: Practically, router needs to emit fallback_{reason}_count so routing policies can react in real time. Runtime should emit oom_kill_count, degraded_mode_enter_total, degraded_mode_exit_total so root cause is clear.

susan: For timeouts we should distinguish client-side cancellations vs server-side processing timeouts: timeout.client vs timeout.server labels. Otherwise we mis-route blame.

marie: Alerting/retention thoughts: baseline alerts: 5xx_rate > 1% p95 over 5m for a route; fallback_rate > 0.5% for prod routes. Keep high-cardinality tags but rollups for long retention.

benji: On the dashboard UX: include a rollout view that shows canary vs baseline and an automatic regression flag when error delta > threshold. Also show per-model-variant diffusion so model changes are visible.

devops-bot: heads-up: metrics ingestion -> grafana is metrics-prod.cluster (no action). Dashboard base URL: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/reliability (internal only).

arjun: Also need counters for degraded-mode entries/exits with labels for trigger (kv_miss, oom, autoscale_delay). Proposed names: runtime.inference.degraded_mode_enter_total, runtime.inference.degraded_mode_exit_total, runtime.inference.fallback_count_total.

susan: Add labels like cause, model_variant, quant_level, batch_size, route. quant_level/batch_size help correlate cost-saving configs to regressions.

marie: One more: quota_denied_count should be emitted by the quota service and treated separately from fallbacks. Quota-induced fallbacks need a distinct label so product can see user impact.

benji: I'll draft a metrics proto/JSON schema with enum values for fallback_reason and degradation_trigger. Will post a PR with examples and suggested metric names by EOD tomorrow.

arjun: Thanks — helps a lot. Sync Wed 10am still good for everyone? @benji @marie @susan

benji: Wed 10 works for me.

marie: OK for me.

susan: good.

benji: Quick sample metric lines to validate format:```
runtime.inference.requests_total{route="/v1/generate",model="redwood-13b",region="us-west-2",tier="prod"} 12456
runtime.inference.fallback_count{reason="kv_miss",route="/v1/generate",model_variant="redwood-13b-q4_0"} 12
```

arjun: perfect — if folks can skim the proto when I post it we can lock names before the sync. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
